entries.verbatim: I propose that adopting a visible, documented tracking system will eliminate ambiguity regarding chore assignments. This assumes that the roommates are willing to agree to a formal structure and that the avoiding friend's withdrawal is a reaction to conflict rather than a fundamental refusal to contribute.
